configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.displayName: CUDA engine with text normaliser and voice cloning
configurePresets.description: Needs CUDA 12.8 or newer, the FFmpeg development libraries and the text dependencies built by tools/build_text_deps.py. Set the KT2N_TEXT_DEPS environment variable to their prefix (or pass -DKT2N_TEXT_DEPS=<prefix>).

configurePresets.name: no-cloning
configurePresets.displayName: CUDA engine with text normaliser, without voice cloning
configurePresets.description: Like default, but without voice cloning, so the FFmpeg development libraries are not needed.

configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.displayName: Development: default plus tests, warnings as errors
configurePresets.description: Like default, with the test suite and with compiler warnings treated as errors.

configurePresets.name: hip
configurePresets.displayName: AMD Radeon (HIP / ROCm) engine with text normaliser and voice cloning
configurePresets.description: Needs ROCm 7.1 or newer (HIP and rocRAND), the FFmpeg development libraries and the text dependencies built by tools/build_text_deps.py (KT2N_TEXT_DEPS). Builds for RDNA3 and RDNA4 (gfx1100, gfx1101, gfx1102, gfx1200, gfx1201); set KT2N_HIP_ARCHS to change that.

configurePresets.name: hip-dev
configurePresets.displayName: AMD Radeon development: hip plus tests
configurePresets.description: Like hip, with the test suite.

configurePresets.name: wheel
configurePresets.displayName: Python wheel (Linux): CUDA engine with text normaliser and voice cloning from decoded audio
configurePresets.description: What the kitten-inference-tts2-cu12 wheel ships (tts-2/packaging/build_wheel_linux.sh). Like default, but cloning takes decoded audio only (the command-line tool decodes the reference audio with the system's ffmpeg program, so no FFmpeg libraries are linked), no tests or examples, and a smaller library: portable GPU code (PTX) only for the newest architecture, compressed GPU code, unused host code dropped and symbols stripped. The GPU code of every architecture is the same as the default build's.

configurePresets.name: cuda-portable
configurePresets.displayName: CUDA build of the AMD code paths (validation only)
configurePresets.description: Compiles the portable software forms of every SM-specific instruction, the code an AMD build runs, for SM 7.5 and SM 12.0, with tests. For checking the AMD paths on an NVIDIA GPU; slower than the default build.

configurePresets.name: windows
configurePresets.displayName: Windows: CUDA engine with text normaliser, without voice cloning (MSVC + Ninja)
configurePresets.description: Run from an x64 Native Tools prompt for Visual Studio 2022 (vcvars64) with CUDA 12.8, CMake and Ninja on PATH. Set KT2N_TEXT_DEPS to the prefix built by tools/build_text_deps.py. Voice cloning is off (it needs the FFmpeg development libraries).

configurePresets.name: windows-dev
configurePresets.displayName: Windows development: the windows preset plus tests

configurePresets.name: wheel-windows
configurePresets.displayName: Python wheel (Windows): CUDA engine with text normaliser and voice cloning from decoded audio (MSVC + Ninja)
configurePresets.description: What the Windows kitten-inference-tts2-cu12 wheel ships (tts-2/packaging/build_wheel_windows.ps1). Like windows, plus voice cloning from decoded audio (the command-line tool decodes the reference audio with the system's ffmpeg program), the static C runtime (the DLL and programs need no Visual C++ redistributable), portable GPU code (PTX) only for the newest architecture and compressed GPU code. Build the text dependencies with tools/build_text_deps.py --msvc-static-runtime.

testPresets.name: gpu
testPresets.displayName: GPU tests (fail instead of skipping when no GPU is visible)

testPresets.name: hip-cpu
testPresets.displayName: Tests that need no GPU (HIP build)

testPresets.name: hip-gpu
testPresets.displayName: GPU tests on an AMD Radeon (fail instead of skipping when no GPU is visible)

testPresets.name: windows-cpu
testPresets.displayName: Windows: tests that need no GPU
